error.summary: Demonstrated answer-rank shortcuts, rejection of valid source IVPs, and two missing source profiles. All five delivered runner records expose the easy shortcut. Seven stored generated questions reproduce a related weakness. Package unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Solve an inhibited decay IVP by separation, apply initial conditions, evaluate a future temperature and round. Moderate cases additionally calibrate the rate and solve for a target time.
reasoning_steps: Evaluate the requested temperature, or calibrate k and invert for time.
Round and select one of five radio choices.
invariants: Positive decay coefficient and initial temperature above equilibrium.
One correct rounded result among five distinct choices.
permitted_variations: Change valid temperatures, rates and times without adding reasoning stages.
Vary object context, answer position and correct numeric rank.
Update all dependent prompts, solutions and keys together.

findings.description: Default easy banks always contain two values below and two above the correct temperature, making the median invariably correct. Sampled moderate banks and seven stored generated target-time records similarly expose a second-largest-answer shortcut.
findings.reproduction: Run regression.py with the context Python. Runner record 9d4ab96c-d8a2-56aa-91e4-663ddd431436, seed 1403253416, offers 29,64,46,53,26; correct 46 is the median. All five runner survivors behave similarly. inventory-audit.py reproduces the seven affected stored records.
findings.requested_change: Change bank construction so recognizable templates do not determine the correct numeric rank. Preserve valid distractors and source response contracts, retain strict shortcut regressions, and replace the five affected runner records.

findings.description: Requiring every fixed misconception distractor to lie between ambient and initial temperature rejects legitimate IVPs. The omit-ambient recipe imposes an unsupported restriction that accepted easy answers exceed twice ambient.
findings.reproduction: regression.py calls generate('easy',84199,'coffee',parameters={'ambient':23,'initial':80,'rate':'0.25','time':4}). It raises 'Whole bank temperature-domain violation' although the canonical answer is 44. Body parameters 21,40,.06,4 similarly reject the valid answer 36.
findings.requested_change: Construct suitable banks for valid source IVPs instead of restricting the IVP domain to accommodate every fixed distractor recipe. Retain these failing acceptance tests.
